name: Nafarelin
status: FDA-approved for endometriosis (6-month course, adult women) and for central precocious puberty in children
mechanism: A long-lasting copy of GnRH that first stimulates, then shuts down, the pituitary's LH and FSH release, lowering estrogen and testosterone

article.summary: Nafarelin (Synarel) is a nasal-spray GnRH agonist that lowers sex hormones. It is approved to manage endometriosis for six months and to treat central precocious puberty in children.
article.takeaway: Nafarelin is a nasal-spray version of GnRH, the brain hormone that controls sex-hormone production. After a brief rise, repeated dosing switches off the pituitary's output, and estrogen and testosterone fall by about 4 weeks.[^1] It is approved for endometriosis pain and lesions in adult women treated for 6 months, and for central precocious puberty in children.[^1] In trials it relieved endometriosis about as well as danazol, but symptoms returned after treatment, and it causes menopause-like side effects and some bone loss.[^2][^1]
glance: Approved (Synarel) for endometriosis and central precocious puberty[^1]
Endometriosis pain and lesions; early puberty in children
Nasal spray used daily; endometriosis courses are limited to 6 months[^1]
Randomized endometriosis trials against danazol and by course length; pediatric puberty studies[^2][^3][^4]
Prohibited in male athletes at all times (WADA)[^6]

blocks.text: The hypothalamus releases GnRH in pulses, and each pulse tells the pituitary to release LH and FSH, which drive estrogen and testosterone production. Nafarelin is a potent GnRH agonist. At the start it stimulates LH and FSH, causing a temporary rise in sex hormones. Repeated dosing then abolishes that stimulation, and with twice-daily use sex-hormone secretion falls by about 4 weeks, so tissues that depend on those hormones become quiet.[^1] That is why endometrial implants shrink and puberty pauses.

items: **Endometriosis:** management, including pain relief and reduction of endometriotic lesions; experience is limited to women 18 and older treated for 6 months[^1]
**Central precocious puberty:** treatment of children of both sexes whose puberty starts abnormally early, once the diagnosis is confirmed by hormone testing and exclusion of other causes[^1]

rows: 307 women, nafarelin vs danazol for 6 months
Equally effective at reducing endometriosis growth and symptoms; symptoms returned in both groups after treatment; more hot flushes with nafarelin[^2]
Pain fell in both groups with no significant difference; 26% in each group were retreated for recurrence[^3]
Hormone levels, vaginal cytology and growth rate came down over 6 months[^4]

blocks.text: For central precocious puberty, a consensus statement says the adult-height benefit of GnRH analogs is undisputed only in early-onset disease (girls under 6), and few controlled prospective studies exist in children.[^5]

Each spray delivers about 200 micrograms. For central precocious puberty the recommended dose is 1,600 micrograms a day, given as 4 sprays in the morning and 4 in the evening, and it can be raised to 1,800 micrograms if suppression is inadequate. Sneezing during or right after a dose should be avoided because it can reduce absorption. Retreatment of endometriosis is not recommended because safety data beyond 6 months are lacking.[^1]

items: **Common:** hot flashes, headache, emotional lability, decreased libido, vaginal dryness, acne, muscle aches and reduced breast size; nasal irritation occurred in about 10%[^1]
**Bone:** after 6 months, vertebral trabecular bone density fell by an average of 8.7%, with only partial recovery afterward[^1]
**Mood and nervous system:** psychiatric symptoms such as aggression and emotional lability, and convulsions, have been reported with this drug class[^1]
**Ovarian cysts** can appear in the first two months in women with endometriosis[^1]
**Pregnancy:** it can cause fetal harm; it is contraindicated in pregnancy, breast-feeding and undiagnosed abnormal vaginal bleeding[^1]

evidence.label: Strong for endometriosis and puberty suppression
evidence.text: Randomized, double-blind trials support endometriosis symptom relief, though benefit fades after treatment ends.[^2][^3] Evidence for adult height in precocious puberty is strongest in early-onset girls.[^5]

faq.q: Why can it only be used for six months in endometriosis?
faq.a: The label says retreatment cannot be recommended because safety data beyond 6 months are not available, and bone density falls during treatment.[^1]

faq.q: Is nafarelin the same as leuprolide?
faq.a: Both are GnRH agonists with a similar effect, but they are given differently. The label cites a trial in which the nasal spray was clinically comparable to monthly [leuprolide](/peptides/leuprolide) depot injections for endometriosis symptoms.[^1]
WADA prohibits GnRH agonists, including nafarelin, in male athletes at all times as testosterone-stimulating peptides.[^6]
